tasks.label: package:all:skipTests
tasks.detail: Fast build of all modules without tests

tasks.label: install:all:fast
tasks.detail: Parallel install (1 thread per core) skipping tests

tasks.label: build:plugins
tasks.command: $pom=[xml](Get-Content pom.xml -Raw); $mods=@($pom.project.modules.module); $plugins=$mods | Where-Object { $_ -like 'plugins/*' }; if ($plugins -and $plugins.Count -gt 0) { mvn -pl ($plugins -join ',') -am package -DskipTests } else { Write-Host 'No plugin modules detected' }

tasks.label: build:examples
tasks.command: $pom=[xml](Get-Content pom.xml -Raw); $mods=@($pom.project.modules.module); $examples=$mods | Where-Object { $_ -like 'examples/plugins/*' }; if ($examples -and $examples.Count -gt 0) { mvn -pl ($examples -join ',') -am package -DskipTests } else { Write-Host 'No example plugin modules detected' }
tasks.detail: Build example audio and commands plugins

tasks.label: build:template
tasks.command: $pom=[xml](Get-Content pom.xml -Raw); $mods=@($pom.project.modules.module); if ($mods -contains 'plugin-template') { mvn -pl plugin-template -am package -DskipTests } else { Write-Host 'Module plugin-template not present in parent pom' }

tasks.label: run:core
tasks.command: mvn -pl fluxcord-core -am install -DskipTests; cd fluxcord-core/run; mvn -f ../pom.xml exec:java -DskipTests
tasks.detail: Install (skip tests) then start core from run dir

tasks.label: run:core:clean
tasks.command: mvn -pl fluxcord-core -am clean install -DskipTests; cd fluxcord-core/run; mvn -f ../pom.xml exec:java -DskipTests

tasks.label: run:core:debug
tasks.command: mvn -pl fluxcord-core -am install -DskipTests -DforkCount=0; cd fluxcord-core/run; $env:MAVEN_OPTS='-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=*:5005'; mvn -f ../pom.xml exec:java -DskipTests
tasks.detail: Run core with JDWP debug on port 5005

tasks.detail: Run full verify lifecycle (tests + integration if configured)
